content: Community Blood Services is a blood bank that specializes in the collection of blood donations, as well as offering services such as cord blood banking and facilitating bone marrow registration and donations. Established in 1953, this organization operates as a not-for-profit entity and is headquartered in Paramus, New Jersey. Its primary focus is to address the transfusion medicine needs of the community it serves. The organization supplies blood and blood-derived products to a total of 37 hospitals and medical centers. These facilities are located across several counties in New Jersey, including Bergen, Passaic, Morris, Essex, and Hudson. Additionally, Community Blood Services extends its services to New York City, as well as Rockland and Orange counties in New York. Community Blood Services is an accredited member of the American Association of Blood Banks (AABB) and is also affiliated with America’s Blood Centers, reflecting its commitment to maintaining high standards in blood banking and transfusion medicine. The mission of Community Blood Services is to enhance the quality of healthcare in the communities it serves. This is achieved by consistently increasing the availability of blood and ensuring the provision of safe, high-quality transfusion products and services. The organization’s vision is to deliver high-quality blood products to a greater number of patients, thereby improving access to essential transfusion resources. The mission goals of Community Blood Services include serving patients, physicians, and hospitals with reliable and high-quality transfusion products and services.
